answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the river queue naming the delta that holds the sponsor's bond. Thus, every sock puppet costs 6 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the forge record exposes exactly who is still on probation. A new identity serves a probation of 6 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. That is 24 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
